concept.title: Adjusting steering wheel angle and height

li.p: To change the steering wheel angle, pull down the lock release lever (1).
Adjust the steering wheel to the desired forward or back (2) and distance (3).
Move the steering wheel so that it points toward your chest, not toward your face. Make sure you can see the instrument panel warning lights and gauges. After adjusting, pull up the lock.
Push the steering wheel both up and down to make sure it is locked into position.
Adjust the steering wheel to the desired position before driving.

note.p: After adjustment, sometimes the lock-release lever may not lock the steering wheel. If this happens, adjust the steering wheel again to get it to lock. This is not a malfunction. It happens when 2 gears engage, and a small adjustment of either angle or height will correct the issue.
